statusLabelMore: Unit status: {{word}}, and {{more}} more. Show the overview.
sensorBody: The unit keeps ventilating, but frost protection and bypass can't use this reading.

offline.title: Can't reach the unit
offline.bodySince: Showing the last values from {{time}}. Trying again every few seconds.

supplyStall.title: Fault: supply fan not turning
supplyStall.body: No fresh air is coming in. Check the fan for blockage, then restart the unit.

exhaustStall.title: Fault: exhaust fan not turning
exhaustStall.body: Stale air isn't leaving the house. Check the fan for blockage, then restart the unit.

sdCard.title: SD card can't be read
sdCard.body: Settings changes won't be saved until the card works again.

configInvalid.title: Settings file couldn't be loaded
configInvalid.body: The unit is running on the last good copy of its settings, or on its defaults if there is none.

busOvercurrent.title: Module socket switched off
busOvercurrent.body: Too much current was drawn on the extension module socket, so it was switched off. Ventilation keeps running; KNX control is unavailable. Check the module cable, then restart the unit.

filter.title: Change the filters
filter.body: Both filters are due. Change them, then confirm under Settings › Filters.

clock.title: Set the clock
clock.body: The schedule and summer cooling need the time.

defrost.title: Defrosting
defrost.body: Fresh air is paused for a few minutes while ice melts in the heat exchanger.

frost.title: Frost protection is on
frost.body: It's freezing outside, so the exhaust fan runs faster to keep the heat exchanger free of ice.
